comment: Allow-list for internal/template/conformance_corpus_test.go. Templates whose sha256 appears in 'exceptions' are exempt from the zero-FAIL / zero-WARN gate. Each entry MUST cite a tracking issue and SHOULD be removed once the template is repaired (the sha256 will then no longer match, restoring the gate). Use `json2pptx template-check --json <file>` to read the sha256. The list MUST be empty once go-slide-creator-vqad and its children land.
